interface.longDescription: Create and manage Japanese vocabulary flashcards in Nihontekini from ChatGPT. Build decks from a topic, JLPT level or text, look up and explain words, fix or suspend cards, check your learning progress and practice the words you keep forgetting with personalized quizzes. Cards include readings, English meanings, explanations and example sentences, and sync to the Nihontekini iOS app. On a free account, AI agents can add up to 50 cards and create 3 quizzes per UTC calendar month; studying your own cards is not limited. Connect your Nihontekini account to start.
defaultPrompt: Add 20 N5 food words to a Kitchen deck.
Quiz me on the Japanese words I keep forgetting.
How many AI cards and quizzes do I have left this month?

name: nihontekini
description: Connect Nihontekini Japanese vocabulary decks, spaced repetition and quizzes to ChatGPT.
